title: MFK human approval record
description: Built by the orchestrator from a GitHub review or PR comment. The orchestrator checks the identity against the GitHub API; agents never write this record.

headSha.description: Approval only covers this commit. A new push voids it.

operation.description: Matches the founder comment, for example approve:device_binding. A thumbs-up or generic LGTM is not an approval.

approverType.description: GitHub account type from the API. Bot and app accounts are rejected.

implementerLogin.description: PR author. The orchestrator rejects the record if it equals approverLogin.
